item_name: Shopify Plus Tech Partner + 3PL referral programs

market_sizing.target_buyer: Two-tier buyer model: (1) Shopify Plus partner managers + 3PL business-development reps who refer Manuva; (2) the multi-channel SMB brand who is the end-customer. Win the partner first, then they co-sell into their book.
market_sizing.business_count_au: Shopify Plus AU merchants: ~1,500-3,000 [uncertain]. AU 3PLs serving DTC/ecommerce: ~30-60 mid-market 3PLs (eStore Logistics, Mr Fulfilment, Efill, Pickpackers, Salmat, Australia Post fulfilment, Bonds3PL, etc.). 3PL business-development reps Manuva needs to know: ~50-100 individuals across the top 20 AU 3PLs.
market_sizing.business_count_secondary: Shopify Plus globally: ~50,000+ merchants; Shopify Certified Technology Partners: ~hundreds. US/UK 3PL ecosystem: hundreds of mid-market 3PLs (ShipBob, Deliverr/Walmart, ShipMonk, ShipHero — many already partner with MRP/IMS tools).
market_sizing.typical_size: Shopify Plus brand: AU$2M-$50M+ revenue, 15-100 staff. 3PL: AU$5M-$100M revenue, often family-owned mid-market AU operators.
market_sizing.annual_revenue_band_aud: End-customer brands AU$2M-$10M most common landing zone for Manuva via this channel
market_sizing.growth_trend: Shopify Plus AU growing 20%+ YoY [uncertain]. 3PL outsourcing trend strong as brands hit ceiling of self-pick. Shopify Plus Tech Partner program restructured Dec 2025 (Tech Track sunset → Service Track tiers); Shopify continues to invest in co-sell.

fit_and_timing.addressable_window: after Xero+MYOB and after Amazon/Woo (months 6-12). Shopify Plus Tech Partner application requires production-quality Shopify integration + customer references first.
fit_and_timing.roadmap_dependency: Shopify integration (shipped pre-launch — good). Amazon connector (for multi-channel Plus brands). Shippit + Australia Post eParcel integrations for 3PL workflow. Wholesale/B2B module for Plus brands selling B2B.
fit_and_timing.typical_tier: Pro ($499) — these are bigger brands than vertical SMB

economics.incumbent_pricing: Shopify Plus Tech Partner referral economics: 20% recurring commission on referred Plus merchant's base platform fee (~AU$460/mo per Plus merchant). Plus referral bonus: $2,500 USD per Plus plan merchant in APAC (Manuva refers TO Shopify Plus, gets paid). For inventory/MRP apps recommended BY Shopify Plus: no formal cash commission to the app, but inclusion in 'recommended apps' list + Strategic Partner Manager support drives 3-5x lead volume. 3PL referral programs in AU: mostly informal — 3PLs refer brands to SaaS tools they integrate with; commissions where they exist are typically AU$200-$1,000 per converted referral or 10-15% rev share for 12 months.
economics.willingness_to_pay_aud: Shopify Plus + 3PL partners want: free Manuva access for their internal team, co-marketing budget, dedicated partner Slack, occasional MDF (market development funds) for joint webinars. Cash commissions are secondary to integration quality and reliable co-sell motion.
economics.estimated_arpu_aud: AU$499/mo ARPU on referred customers (almost all Pro tier)
economics.expansion_revenue_potential: 5 — Plus brands grow into multi-channel + add-on usage rapidly
economics.churn_risk: 1 — Plus + 3PL referred customers churn very low (deep integration; partner relationships enforce stickiness)
economics.cac_estimate_aud: Cash CAC: AU$300-$800 (referral bonus or rev share). Founder-time CAC: 150-300 hours over 6-12 months to bootstrap Shopify Plus Tech Partner status + 3-5 active 3PL partnerships. Effective per-customer CAC AU$500-$1,500 once channel is producing.

outreach_fit.cold_outbound_feasibility: 3 — Shopify Plus partner managers are inundated; need warm intro or strong demo. 3PL BD reps respond to demo offers, especially if Manuva can show 'we'll be your inventory layer above your customers' Shopify'.
outreach_fit.inbound_content_fit: 4 — operator content + 3PL integration case studies perform well; Shopify Plus blog accepts guest posts from Certified Partners
outreach_fit.founder_market_fit_proxy: 4 — Plus + 3PL partners care about technical reliability and integration quality more than industry tenure
outreach_fit.case_study_acquisition_cost: Medium — 3-6 months of relationship-building per partner before first co-sold customer; high LTV when it lands

foot_in_door_fit.trial_to_paid_benchmark: Partner-referred end-customers: 40-55% conversion (high because partner pre-qualifies and shepherds onboarding)
foot_in_door_fit.recommended_foot_in_door_motion: RECOMMENDED MANUVA SHOPIFY PLUS + 3PL TACTIC: Two-track motion. TRACK A (Shopify Plus): defer formal Shopify Certified Technology Partner application until Manuva has 5+ paying Plus customers (likely month 12-15). Until then, build the relationship: list on Shopify App Store (free), submit to Plus app showcase, engage with AU Shopify Plus partner managers via LinkedIn + Sydney/Melbourne happy hours. Focus initial Plus motion on direct outbound to multi-channel Plus brands (see item 25). TRACK B (3PL — the higher-leverage track in year 1): pick 2-3 strategic AU 3PLs (eStore Logistics, one Sydney 3PL, one Melbourne 3PL) and build deep integration partnerships. Offer: free Manuva for 3PL internal use, co-branded landing page, 15% rev share on referred customers for 24 months, joint case study with first 3 mutual customers. 3PLs WANT MRP layers because they don't want to be inventory-system-of-record. Approach 3PL BD reps with 'we're the inventory layer above your customers' Shopify; we make your onboarding easier'. Target 3-5 active 3PL partnerships by month 12; expect each to refer 2-5 customers/year.
foot_in_door_fit.rollout_phase: Phase 2-3 (months 6-18) — 3PL relationships start month 6; Shopify Plus Tech Partner formal status year 2

competitive_context.current_dominant_tool: Current best-practice playbook in inventory/MRP SaaS: file Shopify App Store listing + court Shopify Plus partner managers + integrate with top 3-5 AU 3PLs. Cin7 has done this best in AU (deep eStore Logistics + Shippit integrations + Shopify Plus Tech Partner status). Linnworks invested in 3PL channel heavily. Katana's Shopify Plus partnership is loose.
competitive_context.competitor_gaps_for_this_segment: Cin7 owns the AU 3PL+Shopify Plus channel but is expensive and complex. Manuva opportunity: become the easier, cheaper, AU-native MRP that 3PLs actually like onboarding their customers onto (faster TTV = less 3PL support burden). 3PL partners would prefer recommending a tool whose AU$249-$499 fits their SMB customers vs Cin7 at AU$1K+.
competitive_context.user_satisfaction_signals: Shopify Plus forum: 'we need a real BOM/inventory layer above Shopify Plus' threads; 3PL ops engineers complain about Cin7 onboarding time; eStore Logistics public roadmap mentions partner integrations as priority. Shopify Q4 2025 Tech Partner reshuffle (Tech Track sunset) creates opening for new entrants.
competitive_context.competitor_concentration: Cin7 dominant in AU 3PL channel; opportunity for #2 position
competitive_context.integration_dependency_list: Shopify Plus Admin API, Shopify Flow, Shopify Functions (for B2B/wholesale), Shippit API, Aus Post eParcel API, eStore Logistics 3PL Central / proprietary API, Mr Fulfilment / Efill APIs, Klaviyo (Plus brands all run Klaviyo)

partner_channels.industry_association_sponsorship: Online Retailer Sydney sponsorship (AU$15-50K — out of solo budget); cheaper: Power Retail / Inside Retail content (AU$2-8K), MEGA event sidecar (AU$1-5K), eStore Logistics open-day co-sponsor (relationship-based, often free)

profitability_math.realistic_12mo_customer_count_solo: 3-8 customers via 3PL channel in months 9-12; Shopify Plus Tech Partner formal status not realistic in year 1 but informal Plus referrals can yield 2-4 customers in months 9-12
profitability_math.path_to_first_3k_5k_mrr_aud: Not the PRIMARY path to AU$3-5K (that's items 26 + 28 — design partners + Xero/MYOB). This is the path BEYOND $5K toward $10K+ MRR. Sequence: (1) Months 0-6 focus on Charter Partners + Xero accountant channel; (2) Months 6-9 ship Amazon/Woo; (3) Months 6-12 initiate 3-5 3PL relationships in parallel (low daily time investment); (4) Months 9-15 first 3PL-referred customers land; (5) Year 2 apply for Shopify Certified Technology Partner status with 5+ Plus customer references in hand.
profitability_math.customers_needed_for_1m_arr_aud: ~165 customers at AU$499. Channel can deliver 50-80 over 3 years.
profitability_math.solo_founder_bandwidth_fit: 3 — 3PL partner relationships are high-leverage but slow (3-6 months to first referral). Shopify Plus formal status is too time-expensive in year 1 for a solo founder. Pick 3PL track + informal Shopify Plus presence.
profitability_math.gross_margin_sensitivity: Slight erosion from 15% rev share to 3PL partner; offset by higher ARPU + lower churn
profitability_math.priority_ranking: 3 — important year-2 motion; in year 1 limit to lightweight 3PL relationships only. Lower priority than design partners (item 26) and accountant channel (item 28) for a solo founder.
profitability_math.risks_and_notes: RECOMMENDED MANUVA-SPECIFIC TACTIC PARAGRAPH: In year 1, defer formal Shopify Plus Tech Partner certification (requires 5+ Plus customers and meaningful integration investment) and instead pursue 3 strategic AU 3PL partnerships. Sequence: month 6 outreach to BD reps at eStore Logistics, one Sydney mid-market 3PL, one Melbourne mid-market 3PL; offer free Manuva for 3PL internal use + 15% rev share for 24 months + joint case studies. By month 12 aim for 3-5 active 3PL partnerships referring 5-12 customers/year. In parallel, build informal Shopify Plus presence: list on Shopify App Store free tier, attend AU Plus partner happy hours, engage AU partner managers via LinkedIn. Apply for Shopify Certified Technology Partner status in year 2 with 5+ Plus customer references. Risks: (1) Shopify Plus Tech Partner has 0% rev share until $1M earnings, 15% above — favorable economics but listing-quality bar is high; verify current 2026 requirements with Shopify partner team before investing; (2) 3PL relationships are slow — expect 3-6mo to first referral; (3) AU 3PL market is consolidating (eStore Logistics dominant); spreading bets across 3 prevents over-dependence; (4) 3PL integrations are technically expensive; pick one (eStore Logistics) and ship best-in-class first, then expand; (5) defer Shippit-specific work until 3PL channel proves value (Shippit is shipping-software, not 3PL — different lever).
